content: Hi all ! Can I get a show of hands from people who contribute(d) to TauCeti. I've been reading around the project (some roadmaps, the contribution guidelines etc), and as an engineer I'm a big fan of the high degree of automation put in the project (esp the review rubrics), but I also like to speak to humans sometimes.
Eg one thing I noticed is that a number of tickets point to "stuck PRs" ( https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/issues e.g. TauCeti#1907 ) and would like to understand how to help unblock.
Welcome! There's a whole channel #Tau Ceti dedicated to the project. It's mostly human discussion, and a few threads where the bots post reports. Shall I move your thread there?
hi @Johan Commelin , yes please. Apologies , I am new to Zulip as well
